Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps for pilot onboarding

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for hosting the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Pilot scope: 3 API endpoints (summarization, structured extraction, embeddings) for a 6-week pilot with a single dataset.
- Success criteria: latency under 300ms p95 for request mix, cost target <$0.012/token, and extraction F1 > 0.86 on your eval set.
- Stakeholders we heard on the call: you (product lead), Rajiv (ML), Marta / procurement (vendor intake), and finance (invoice routing).

Actions I propose:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer for final sign-off (name + email)?
2) Can you introduce the procurement contact who manages vendor packets and PO timing?
3) I attached a draft SOW for the pilot (HealthGrid_Redwood_Pilot_SOW_v1.docx) — please flag any commercial items to adjust.
4) If procurement needs SOC2 or vendor questionnaire up front, we can surface our SOC2 report and a completed vendor security questionnaire.

Target timeline we discussed: pilot kick on/around July 1. To hit that we’ll need a PO or signed SOW + vendor onboarding details by the week of June 21. If that’s aggressive, let me know the gating items and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looping in Priyom (solutions) and Monica (CS) to help with procurement packet and onboarding checklist.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Hi Priyom / Jasmine / team —

Thanks for the packet. A few notes from procurement intake: 

- We require: vendor intake form (online), completed W-9, and SOC 2 Type II report when handling vendor software that will process customer data. If a SOC2 is not available, we accept completed security questionnaires plus a remediation plan.
- Typical vendor onboarding timeline is 10–15 business days after the packet is complete; contracts/PO creation usually adds another 3–5 business days. Total realistic timeline: 2–3 weeks once we have everything.
- For first payment we often set the initial invoice to Net45 while vendor banking details are verified; subsequent invoices switch to your agreed Net30.
- Please send a sample invoice (PDF) and your remittance/bank details. 

Quick intake link: https://healthgrid.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/vendor-intake
Procurement contact: Marta Lopez (procurement@healthgrid.com)

We can accept the SOW provided, but please confirm the PO entity name is exactly: HealthGrid Therapeutics, Inc. and provide remittance address for the invoice header.

Regards,
Marta Lopez
